text: The subdialog helper scrolls the opening button into view before synthesizing a click. The tag-removal step repeats that preparation after a dialog closes. Both use centered instant scrolling, and accepted code retains the calls. Existing assertions check tag state; they do not directly assert scroll position or prove the reported timeout is cured.
title: Preferences dialog tests scroll their click targets into view
